e: From ἀκμή (akmḗ), meaning "point, edge", for its typically spiky crystals + -ite.
Borrowed from Ancient Greek ἀκμή (akmḗ, “point; high point”).
q: The Latin tong, euen whan it was, as the Grecians say, in ακμη, that is, at the hiest pitch of all perfitenesse.

Eum.: Our Loves what are they
But howerly Sacrifices, only wanting
The prease and tumult of Solemnity?
If then i'th' heat and Achme of Devotion
We drink a new fiame in, can it be ought
But to increase the Worship?
